risk_if_not_implemented: Without Data Rights Management (DRM), sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Intellectual Property / Trade Secret Loss (R-EX-9), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), Loss of Data Integrity (R-IP-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14).

compensating_control_1.name: Access Enforcement
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to enforce Logical Access Control (LAC) permissions that conform to the principle of "least privilege."
compensating_control_1.justification: Access Enforcement (IAC-25) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Data Rights Management (DRM) (DCH-39) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Encrypting Data At Rest
compensating_control_2.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of data at rest.
compensating_control_2.justification: Encrypting Data At Rest (CRY-07) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Data Rights Management (DRM) (DCH-39) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
